shots.what_happens: A 0.3 s pure-black frame opens the video before any picture or voice-over (first word w0 starts later, in s002).
shots.build_rebuild: Start the composition with ~9 frames of solid black before the first footage layer appears.

shots.focal_element: A retro beige CRT monitor (badge reads 'Kanonic') showing an early-search-engine-style homepage
shots.transition_other: out of the black opening slate (exact cut vs fade-from-black not visible at 2 fps)
shots.typography: Multicolour serif display headline styled like the late-1990s Google wordmark, mixed case, normal tracking; tiny unreadable link/body text below. The headline swaps from '35 years ago' to 'Google!' around 3.5 s.
shots.what_happens: Dim room, camera slowly pulls back / drifts from the glowing CRT to reveal a keyboard below while the screen headline reads '35 years ago' and then swaps to the retro 'Google!' logo, matching the VO 'the humble search engine was born' (w0-w8) and leading into w9-w11.
shots.build_rebuild: Composite a recreated retro search homepage onto a CRT-monitor plate, set the headline in a multicolour serif ('35 years ago'), swap it to the wordmark at the VO word 'search', and apply a slow 4.7 s pull-out with screen glow.

shots.focal_element: White typed caption over a stock shot of a bookstore with angled book displays
shots.typography: Clean geometric/neo-grotesque sans, bold-ish weight, title case, normal tracking, white with a blinking text-caret bar; placed left of centre. Font guess (low confidence): Inter.
shots.what_happens: Quick 0.4 s cut to a shallow-depth-of-field bookstore shot; a typewriter caption begins spelling 'World' letter by letter in sync with VO 'the world' (w12-w13).
shots.build_rebuild: Hard-cut a stock bookstore clip under a white sans caption that types on character by character with a trailing caret bar, starting at word w12.

shots.focal_element: Film clip of a bearded man swinging toward camera, framed by a red paint-smear vignette, with the typed caption over him
shots.typography: Same white sans caption with caret continuing to type; title case, same position left of centre.
shots.what_happens: 0.5 s cut to a dramatic film clip seen through a ring of red paint on glass; the persistent caption keeps typing 'World at You' over the cut, matching VO 'world at your' (w13-w15).
shots.build_rebuild: Keep the typewriter caption as a top layer that persists across cuts and continue typing it while a new full-frame film clip hard-cuts in underneath.

shots.focal_element: Close-up of a hand with a gold ring typing on a beige keyboard, under the caption
shots.typography: Same white sans typewriter caption with caret, title case, completes to the full phrase.
shots.what_happens: Retro-video close-up of fingers typing (with a magenta colour artefact on the first frame) while the caption completes 'World at Your Fingertips' on VO 'fingertips' (w16). By the 7.0 s contact frame the picture already shows the black-and-white factory film clip of s006 with no caption.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut to a lo-fi keyboard-typing clip and finish the typewriter caption exactly on the VO word w16, then clear the caption before the next cut.

shots.focal_element: Huge red distressed word over black-and-white silent-film factory footage, with the performer passing in front of the letters
shots.typography: Headline: condensed, hand-painted/brush-textured display face, all caps, tight tracking, red, spanning the frame width and partly occluded by the actor (depth-layered). Label: small white bold lowercase sans with a right-pointing arrow.
shots.what_happens: Letterboxed vintage factory footage with the word 'REVOLUTIONISED' set behind the dancing actor (he occludes letters), landing on VO 'revolutionized' (w17-w18); by the 8.5 s contact frame the picture shows a server rack with a 'first web server' arrow callout, as VO continues 'the world we live in' (w19-w23).
shots.build_rebuild: Rotoscope the foreground actor and place a full-width red condensed brush-type word between the background plate and the matte so the actor passes in front of the text, timed to the VO word w18.
